source.title: Subjective signal strength distinguishes reality from imagination

confidence_rationale: A well-designed dissent recorded as a first-class result. The paper shows reality judgements in adults depend on whether a combined imagery-plus-perception signal crosses a subjective strength threshold, with vivid imagery becoming subjectively indistinguishable from perception. That supports the EXISTENCE of a reality-status decision with a dedicated failure mode, and simultaneously argues it is a fallible inference over a shared graded variable rather than a protected provenance tag riding with the content. Mixed, at moderate confidence.
failure_signatures: Vivid enough imagery crosses the reality threshold and is judged real -- the confabulation-like signature MECH-545 predicts for a REALITY-STATUS boundary lesion, but produced here WITHOUT any lesion, by the normal operation of a threshold mechanism.

If provenance were a separately preserved label, imagery vividness should not affect the reality judgement; the observed dependence is evidence against the 'separable relation' form of the candidate and for a reconstruction-at-the-receiver form.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Across psychophysics and neuroimaging, judgements that a stimulus was real depended on whether the combined perceptual-plus-imagery signal exceeded a subjective strength threshold; sufficiently vivid imagery was judged as real.
mapping.ree_translation: ARC-142 states that the contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, not a fixed data structure. This paper is evidence about the mechanism by which reality status is recovered in humans: not read from a tag, but inferred from a graded quantity that observed and imagined content share. Under GOV-CONTRACT-1 a candidate shown to be translatable-around or reconstructed rather than preserved is a preserved negative finding. Paired with Garrison et al. 2015, which shows the substrate that makes this judgement (paracingulate sulcus) predicts hallucination regardless of sensory modality, the picture is a subsystem-independent DECISION over a subsystem-shared SIGNAL.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Human adults with verbal reality judgements in a laboratory imagery task. The threshold account may describe how the relation is READ OUT for report without describing how it is carried between engines; the two are separable and MECH-545's within-boundary control is the assay that would separate them.
mapping.source_context: Human adult psychophysics with concurrent neuroimaging, imagery-perception interference paradigm.

confidence_components.notes: Recorded as the principal dissent for REALITY STATUS; direction mixed because it supports the distinction's existence and failure mode while contradicting the separable-tag form.
